text: This is to advise that a report on Draft 2021 Audited Consolidated Financial Statements will be on the agenda of the Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund May 25, 2022 meeting. Additional time is required for the Audit Committee to meet and for the Auditor to complete the report, but it will be circulated in advance of the meeting
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund received the item for information.
